integrity: The full all-parameter proof reduces the constrained diagonal problem to a tridiagonal Perron eigenvalue, balances two outer links using a fixed-product extremum, and minimizes an explicit scalar function whose derivative changes sign exactly when K times the cubed outer link ratio equals two. The exact rational endpoint is replayed by a standard-library program; this finite replay is not the proof of global optimality.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic classification for the specified four-state uniform-rate positive Jordan cascade, positive diagonal quadratic norms, and spectral condition-number budgets at least one. No nondiagonal metric, unequal-rate chain, higher dimension, or floating-point stability claim. Nonexpansion is in the induced weighted norm, not necessarily Euclidean norm.
title: Sharp metric-conditioning phase transition for a four-stage positive cascade
